rule.name: iOS WKWebView JavaScript Execution Sink
rule.rule_desc: The application renders web content, executes scripts, or exposes a native messaging interface. Resolve navigation trust, origin isolation, and validation at the native boundary.
rule.vuln_desc: Attacker-controlled web content may execute in a trusted context or invoke native operations, exposing session data or application privileges when isolation and per-operation checks are insufficient.
rule.developer: Restrict navigation and message origins to required trusted sources. Avoid dynamic script construction, minimize native bridge methods, validate message inputs, and authorize sensitive native operations.
rule.reviewer: Audit WebView content sources and JS bridge interactions. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: iOS Pasteboard Usage
rule.rule_desc: The application reads the shared clipboard or pasteboard. Review whether the read follows an explicit paste action and whether the returned content enters logs, storage, or network requests.
rule.vuln_desc: Passwords, payment details, or other private content copied from another application could be collected or disclosed if clipboard reads occur without user intent or the content is sent to an unauthorized recipient. Platform access restrictions and the actual handling of the data determine exposure.
rule.developer: Read clipboard content only for an explicit user paste action. Process only the value needed for that action, avoid logging or transmitting it unnecessarily, and respect platform clipboard access restrictions.
rule.reviewer: Review pasteboard writes for sensitive data exposure. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: iOS UserDefaults Secret Storage Marker
rule.rule_desc: The application stores sensitive values or configures protection for persistent data. Determine the actual storage location, backup policy, and lock-state access restrictions.
rule.vuln_desc: An actor with access to unprotected application files, backups, or overly broad keychain access may recover credentials or private records and use them outside the intended trust boundary.
rule.developer: Use the platform credential or key store for secrets and appropriate authenticated encryption and file protection for private records. Minimize stored data, backup exposure, and lock-state accessibility.
rule.reviewer: Inspect local storage choices for sensitive fields. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: iOS Insecure URL Usage
rule.rule_desc: The code declares an entry point, model, destination, or configuration value that may cross a trust boundary. Identify callers, recipients, and the required data-access policy.
rule.vuln_desc: A boundary that trusts unauthorized callers or exposes private output may permit data disclosure or state changes. A declaration, address, or architectural marker alone does not establish such a failure.
rule.developer: Trace the actual boundary, restrict accepted inputs and recipients, and enforce authentication and object-level authorization where required. Verify both authorized and denied use cases.
rule.reviewer: Audit API endpoint definitions and networking calls. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: iOS Hardcoded Secret Marker
rule.rule_desc: The checked source or build configuration embeds potentially sensitive credential or key material. Determine whether it is active and whether it reaches distributed artifacts or logs.
rule.vuln_desc: A party who can read exposed source, artifacts, configuration, or logs may recover active secrets and access the protected service or decrypt data with the secret owner’s privileges.
rule.developer: Remove active secrets from source and build layers, rotate exposed values, and load replacements through a restricted secret-management facility. Use narrowly privileged, short-lived credentials.
rule.reviewer: Validate no production credentials are embedded in app code. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
